svg.title: Tool catalogs: how many, and how delivered
svg.desc: Bar chart of enabled tool count per harness, with every tool shipped as a full schema on every request (a flat catalog). Copilot CLI 19 tools (8,064 shape tokens). Claude CLI 27 tools (18,877). Copilot in VS Code 56 tools, 38 from Copilot plus 18 from notebook and browser extensions (about 16,622). None of the three used progressive disclosure, name-only advertising, or a tool-search step in these captures; the difference is tool count, not delivery strategy. VS Code has a documented virtual-tools grouping that activates only above about 128 tools and was not triggered here.
svg.text: All three ship a flat catalog — full schemas, every request
Enabled tools and how they are delivered on the first request. Claude Sonnet 4.5, MCP off.
The difference between harnesses is tool count (19 → 27 → 56), not delivery: no progressive disclosure or tool-search step appeared in these captures.
Of VS Code's 56 tools, 18 come from notebook + browser extensions (user-installed), not Copilot. Virtual-tools grouping activates only above ~128 tools.
Sources: wire/relay bodies (CLIs) and export tools array (VS Code, t6_B agent turn). Tool tokens are chars/4 shape estimates.
